title: Tutorial "complete" toast is overwritten, and toasts replace each other instantly
details: (Found in the 2026-09-26 code review, owner asked for all of these to be fixed) tests/e2e/tutorial.spec.js fails repeatably and blocks every push. Talking to Tomas completes the last step before his dialog opens, so the delayed toast fires mid-dialog and the sword toast replaces it. Toasts need a queue.

thread.author: agent
thread.text: Messages now queue one after another; the tutorial message waits for the conversation to close.

resolution.test: tests/e2e/tutorial.spec.js › FB-0036: toast is a queue -- messages show one after another instead of clobbering each other
